title: The etale locus is open for a finite-type morphism of locally Noetherian schemes
statement: If a morphism of locally Noetherian schemes is of finite type, the set of points where it is etale is open.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 29.37.17, Tag 0476 (the etale locus W is open and is preserved by the stated base changes), together with the finite-type local criterion in More on Morphisms, Lemma 37.12.3, Tag 0A43

mathlib_searches.query: open etale locus finite type morphism scheme
mathlib_searches.results: Algebra.etaleLocus and Algebra.mem_etaleLocus_iff; no scheme-level infinitesimal result
